instructions: Author geometry only from supplied project records and candidate values.

No framework fallback or unstated building dimension will be supplied.

proposal.label: gathering-shelter-concept-001 spatial option
proposal.rationale: The six-by-five-metre footprint is economical and legible. The main four-metre-deep zone accommodates an eight-person gathering arrangement, while the one-metre-deep edge band consolidates storage and a recessed sheltered arrival without fragmenting the central space.
proposal.typology_hypothesis: A compact rectangular pavilion with one primary daylit room and a shallow service-and-entry band along one edge.
